entities.name: Akiri
entities.description: A legendary Kor warrior and line-slinger from Zendikar.

entities.name: Zareth San
entities.description: Merfolk saved by Akiri who became her lover; killed by the Lithoform Core.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker who sought the Lithoform Core and pushed Akiri off the Skyclave; later compleated.

entities.name: Lithoform Core
entities.description: Powerful artifact sought at the Murasa Skyclave.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who saved Akiri and asked her to guide him.

entities.name: Linvala
entities.description: Angel who joined the attack on Nahiri.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: Place where the compleated Nahiri returned.

events.summary: Akiri saved Zareth San during the destruction of Sea Gate.
events.quote: the merfolk Zareth San whom Akiri saved during the destruction of Sea Gate

events.summary: Akiri's party was hired to travel with Nahiri to the Murasa Skyclave to find the Lithoform Core.
events.quote: were hired to travel with Nahiri to the Murasa Skyclave to find the Lithoform Core

events.summary: Nahiri used the Core and killed Zareth San in the blast.
events.quote: which also killed Zareth San in the blast

events.summary: Akiri threatened to drop the Core; Nahiri paralyzed her, took it back and pushed her off the Skyclave.
events.quote: and then took back the artifact, and pushed Akiri over the edge

events.summary: Nissa and Jace saved Akiri, who agreed to guide Jace to the Singing City.
events.quote: Akiri was saved by Nissa Revane and Jace Beleren

events.summary: Akiri, Linvala, Kaza, Orah and Tazri fought the compleated Nahiri in Emeria's Skyclave, which crashed with her inside.
events.quote: the Skyclave breaking and crashing to the ground with Nahiri still inside

relations.quote: eventually became her lover and trusted friend
she became a member of the Sea Gate Expeditionary House
Akiri threatened to drop the Core over the edge of the floating ruin
